metadata.image-description: In a high-tech workspace bathed in blue hues and electric shadows, a woman with vibrant magenta hair intently works at a glowing, map-like interface surrounded by a ring of dynamic data screens and sci-fi engineering tools. Her posture conveys focus and determination as she drafts or analyzes complex information on the illuminated surface. The environment is both cluttered and purposeful, a visual symphony of wires, mechanical limbs, and interactive holograms, embodying the convergence of creativity, technology, and exploration. The scene blends cyberpunk aesthetics with narrative-driven futurism, evoking themes of prompt engineering, space navigation, and digital craftsmanship.

coverImageAlt: Navy folded aperture drawing in translucent material ribbons and projecting a finished mountain landscape.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a refined aperture folds raw visual materials—light, texture, depth, and motion—into a controlled finished image plane
Scene/backdrop: warm paper fabrication table in a deep slate studio with calm negative space
Subject: one large origami-like navy aperture with cyan inner folds drawing loose material ribbons inward and projecting a crisp dimensional landscape tile; a small orange iris segment signals fine control
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with folded metal-paper, translucent fabric, and precise sculptural detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; bold circular aperture offset near center with a single output plane; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: advanced, controlled, imaginative, quietly cinematic
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: folded matte metal-paper, translucent textile ribbons, frosted acrylic, soft studio shadows
Constraints: aperture and image plane completely unmarked; no interface or parameter notation; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: provider branding, command syntax, camera equipment, generic stacked lenses, image grids, glowing brains, Fluent-like gradients, clutter
